summary: This bill expands and codifies the Department of Agriculture's Rural Hospital Technical Assistance Program, renaming it the Rural Health Care Facility Technical Assistance Program, to provide technical assistance and training to a broader range of rural health care facilities to help them identify development needs, improve financial and business strategies, and access federal loan and grant programs.

scores.thoughts: This bill authorizes appropriations of up to $2,000,000 annually for fiscal years 2026 through 2030 to establish and maintain a technical assistance program for rural health care facilities. This directly increases government spending.

The bill aims to support rural health care facilities by providing technical assistance to improve their financial stability and operational efficiency, thereby strengthening healthcare delivery in rural areas and preventing facility closures. This indirectly supports the social safety net by ensuring access to essential health services for vulnerable populations in rural areas.

The bill authorizes up to $2 million annually for FY2026-2030 to fund a new technical assistance program at USDA, with no offsetting revenue or spending cuts. This constitutes new federal outlays that would increase the deficit to support rural health priorities, though the authorization is small and the bill's primary focus is program design rather than fiscal policy.
